title: Synthetic mixed-audit scaling against exhaustive sparse recomputation

protocol.generator: NumPy PCG64; signed fixed coefficients and seeded scaling; overlapping and missing source labels
protocol.cache_policy: Clear all three scalar arithmetic caches before each method; fresh solver per method/trial; alternate method order by dataset index + trial
protocol.workload: Both methods share one GraphEngine load and cohort. Each solves all four budget cells for the same three compounds. Naive shares each full-world rerank across all three; envelopes share all slices across all three.
protocol.timing: perf_counter wall seconds; setup, solve, shared load/cohort and independent verification are separate; ratios exclude verification and shared load/cohort
protocol.independence: Naive independently recomputes full sparse path products and ranks in each world, without contribution tables, envelopes, production rank helpers or production replay; the finite arithmetic scorer is deliberately shared
protocol.verification: All four frontier cells and action counts match exhaustive results; every certificate verifies; every emitted witness is independently recomputed by full sparse products
protocol.limitations: Small synthetic graphs on one recorded runtime, fixed degrees and one disease; no claim about Hetionet-scale latency, asymptotic exponent, predictive accuracy or general graph neural networks; runtime ratios include Python and certificate serialization overhead. The reference is literal exhaustive recomputation, not the fastest possible exhaustive solver.

proof.algorithm: conditional batched one-edge envelopes and exact disjoint rank allocation
proof.count_semantics: Action representations may produce identical removed unions; counts are not unique edited graphs or measured speedups. All selected 1+1 slices are cached even when the requested rectangle is smaller.

certificates.interpretation: Exact for the declared frozen ranker and the rectangular budget of at most one selected provenance-group withdrawal plus at most one residual BINDS record deletion. A group removes the union of all records carrying its imported annotation; a residual record must survive that withdrawal. All competing compounds change jointly. Group and record budgets are separate units, not equal amounts of evidence. Source labels are not independent suppliers, and a citation need not identify one experiment. This is an evidence-quarantine sensitivity analysis, not a factual retraction, clinical effect, error probability or new biological discovery. Exactness is relative to decimal80-binary64-v1. Unselected annotations, other relation families, larger budgets, new records and model refitting are outside scope.

certificates.interpretation: Exact for the declared frozen ranker and the rectangular budget of at most one selected provenance-group withdrawal plus at most one residual BINDS record deletion. A group removes the union of all records carrying its imported annotation; a residual record must survive that withdrawal. All competing compounds change jointly. Group and record budgets are separate units, not equal amounts of evidence. Source labels are not independent suppliers, and a citation need not identify one experiment. This is an evidence-quarantine sensitivity analysis, not a factual retraction, clinical effect, error probability or new biological discovery. Exactness is relative to decimal80-binary64-v1. Unselected annotations, other relation families, larger budgets, new records and model refitting are outside scope.
